title: Introduce compact anchor runner and delta telemetry fuser for lightweight regression diffs
author: Maya Chen
description:
Summary: Adds a compact 'anchor runner' binary and a delta telemetry fuser utility. The goal is to provide a low-overhead, source-of-truth anchor run that produces compact, mergeable telemetry artifacts suitable for fast regression diffing and long-term storage. Motivation: our current full-profile runs are expensive to store and slow to diff for routine CI catches. This PR introduces a smaller canonical run and a post-processor (delta fuser) that merges per-run deltas into a single compact timeline for downstream change detection.

Design & implementation: 1) compact-anchor-runner: a thin runner executable (go) that replays a representative session mix (token-level sampler + context primer) with deterministic RNG seeding and limited instrumentation. It emits a compact protobuf-lite payload containing: sequence IDs, key kernel-time-annotated spans, p50/p95/p99 microbuckets, and a minimal KV-cache hit map. The payload intentionally omits large token traces and full heap snapshots to keep size < 80KB per run. 2) delta-telemetry-fuser: a python utility that takes multiple compact payloads and produces a fused delta file containing per-cohort summaries and a delta-of-quantiles record optimized for git-friendly diffs. The fuser attaches run-metadata (commit, model, hw-tag) and computes signed checksums to aid reproducibility. 3) reporting pipeline integration: CI step 'anchor-diff' added to the lightweight benchmark pipeline which runs the anchor-runner on a small litmus set, pushes artifacts to the artifact store, and then triggers the fuser to produce a delta artifact consumed by our perf-notifier.

Checklist: - [x] compact runner binary and tests - [x] fuser utility and unit tests - [x] CI integration in lightweight bench workflow - [x] metrics mapping and schema docs - [x] smoke run against staging cluster - [x] reviewer approvals

Files changed (high level): - cmd/compact-anchor-runner/main.go (new) - bench/anchor/primer_sets/short_mix.yaml (new) - bench/anchor/runner_test.go (new) - tools/delta_fuser/fuser.py (new) - tools/delta_fuser/schema.md (new) - ci/workflows/light-bench-anchor.yml (modified) - reporters/anchor-uploader/manifest.go (modified) - docs/bench/compact-anchor.md (new)

Compatibility & migration notes: The compact payload uses a new top-level "anchor_v1" schema that coexists with our existing full-profile outputs. Downstream consumers (perf-notifier and storage indexer) are updated in this PR to accept the new schema. No changes required to existing long-run datasets.

Testing & results: We ran the anchor runner across three representative commits against the p4-staging cluster (same seed). End-to-end CI runtime for the anchor workflow: ~6m (median) vs full profile ~42m. Typical artifact sizes: 48-76KB. Early sensitivity: anchor diffs caught a 6% p95 regression in a small scheduling tweak (reproduced in full-run) with negligible noise after 10 runs.

Rollout plan: 1) Merge to main and enable 'anchor-diff' on the lightweight bench schedule. 2) Monitor false-positive rate for 2 weeks, collect sample diffs. 3) If noise > 10% for a given model cohort, widen primer set and increase sampling.

Follow-ups (tracked in ENG-1107): - add optional micro flamepoint markers to the compact payload for hotspot triage - hook fuser output into automated regression labeling and Slack perf channel - experiment with delta compression for multi-run longitudinal stores

References: Linear tickets ENG-1024, ENG-1107. Related docs: docs/bench/compact-anchor.md. CI runs and artifacts: link to artifact index will be posted in the perf-notifier thread after merge.

release_notes: Introduce a lightweight 'compact anchor' benchmark runner and a 'delta telemetry fuser' to produce compact, mergeable diff artifacts for fast regression detection. Adds CI integration to run anchor diffs on the lightweight bench schedule. No breaking changes to full-profile outputs.
notes_for_ops: When enabling in prod pipeline, ensure artifact-store retention policy is set to 90 days for anchor artifacts. If perf-notifier begins showing elevated noise, revert enabling flag in ci/workflows/light-bench-anchor.yml and open ENG-1107.
